rules.reason: reporting is a leaf: it reads the ledger, and nothing reads it back — an import in this direction would make the thing being reported on depend on its own report
a report is a read of the ledger and of who the invoices belong to; reaching anything else would make reporting a place where behaviour accumulates
billing decides what is owed; how it is collected is downstream, and an invoice that knows about gateways cannot be issued without one
